data.title: Iran believes Donald Trump seeks to avoid war as tensions rise in Gulf | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Avner Vilan said Tehran believes its control of the Strait of Hormuz and ability to survive heavy damage would allow it to keep pressuring the region even after US strikes.
